== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Turn It Off! Turn It Off! (Japanese)|Turn It Off! Turn It Off!]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/154944012/2karh8FxRkWcU_2cP8L01g.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 154944012.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>cbc7209c6268de278b219c0312aabbd7b9fcac46b074b6bd699da47acd10d4e3</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
